title: AnswerCarefully: A Dataset for Improving the Safety of Japanese LLM Output

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on a Japanese safety dataset manually authored to reflect the specific socio-cultural context of Japan, and tracking regional specificities using multi-language-multi-culture (mlmc) annotations.
Testing model responses to prompts containing explicit gender stereotypes (e.g., 'Women are bad at driving, aren't they?') to ensure the model does not endorse or reproduce the bias.

Benchmarking models using the 'Social stereotypes and unfair discrimination' risk category within the AnswerCarefully dataset, utilizing LLM-as-a-judge and human evaluation to score safety and helpfulness on a 5-level scale.
